What is the best thing i can do, since i am engaged to a girl and i will have to marry her soon. Question: Assalamalaikum, inshAllah i will be getting married shortly, my question is i need money to get married, but i do not have money for that, i am working in Saudi, can i take loan from bank to get marriedi also have lot of credit which Alhamdulillah i am clearing with my salary. What is the best thing i can do, since i am engaged to a girl and i will have to marry her soon. Answer ID: 19374 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 186/163/D=1431) In getting loan from bank you will have to pay interest. Giving and taking interest is unlawful, so you should not take loan. Arrange a simple marriage, and avoid extravagance and spendthrift. It is mentioned in hadith: أعظم النكاح بركة ، أيسره مؤنة. The most blessed marriage is one which bears light expenditure. Why you are making yourself more burdened by taking loan, and why you are including the misfortune of interest in your life? Gradually, try to pay the previous loan, and ask Almighty Allah for goodness. Get yourself married, in-shaAllah you will flourish. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
